Written offer of source code: AAC audio decoder (AAC-LC, HE-AAC, HE-AAC v2) feature of NitroOS

The file nitroaacdec.dll (System32 and SysWOW64) contains FFmpeg 9.0.2 (libavcodec and libavutil, LGPL-2.1-or-later),
unmodified, statically linked together with the Media Foundation wrapper (nitroaacdec.c, LGPL-2.1-or-later).

You may have the complete corresponding source code, and everything needed to rebuild and relink the DLL:

 1. The FFmpeg 9.0.2 release tarball, unchanged:
      https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
      SHA-256 8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e
 2. Our wrapper and build: nitroaacdec-full-src-9.0.2-1.tar.xz (the wrapper source, build-aacdec.sh, README.md and these
    notices; FFmpeg itself is not patched). It is published at the address the feature downloads from, in the same
    folder as the DLLs:
      https://repo.nitroos.org/featmgr/aac/<version>-<hash>/nitroaacdec-full-src-9.0.2-1.tar.xz
    (the folder is recorded in the featmgr log of the installation), and in the NitroOS source tree under
    dll/3rdparty/nitro-aacdec.
 3. On a CD or other medium, at the cost of the copying: write to the NitroOS maintainers at the address given on
    https://repo.nitroos.org.

Rebuild: AAC_VARIANT=full build-aacdec.sh <outdir> (mingw-w64 GCC for x86_64 and i686, make, xz). To use a modified
decoder, turn the feature off and replace System32\nitroaacdec.dll and SysWOW64\nitroaacdec.dll (the CLSID is registered
under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\CLSID\{32D186A7-218F-4C75-8876-DD77273A8999}), or register your own build there.

This offer is valid for at least three years from the date you downloaded the feature, and for as long as NitroOS offers
the feature.
